pattern.description: A second snap pull-out (about 0.77x scale over about 4 frames) continuing from e008: medium shot to a wide stage two-shot that reveals the interviewer is a lookalike character, landing just before the repeated 'big' in 'big, big plans'.
pattern.why_premium: Two stepped snap zooms echo the narration's repetition ('big, big'), and the final widen pays off as a visual gag (the interviewer is his double) with no extra cut.

build_hint.gsap: Same camera container as e008, second step: tl.to(camera, {scale: 1, y: '+6%', duration: 0.13, ease: 'expo.out'}) after a hold of about 0.55 s from a scale of about 1.3; both steps use identical durations and eases so the rhythm reads as deliberate.
build_hint.remotion: Piecewise interpolate on the wrapper scale: [1.6, 1.6 -> 1.3 over 4 frames, hold, 1.3 -> 1 over 4 frames] with Easing.out(Easing.exp), clamp; no spring.

notes: Camera verdict pull_out (scale 0.766, pan_y -0.063); motion is almost all camera. b02 is an OCR misread ('6') on Oscar's face, used here as the nearest box to the main subject. b03 is a curtain-fold sliver. No SFX candidates.
